title: Firefighter Academy
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Firefighter Academy - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS669/C/MCE669
outcomes: Perform skills that meet National Fire Protection Association Standard 1001 for firefighter and California State Fire Marshal Standards for Firefighter 1.
Demonstrate written and verbal communications skills required for entry-level firefighter positions.
Analyze emergency and hazardous conditions that are inherent to the firefighting profession.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement. The Program Requirements (29 units) and the Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and are recorded here for the certificate.
Catalog codes are printed with hyphens (FIT-S3A, FIT-S3, EMS-50, EMS-51). They were matched to the closed-list entries FIT S3A, FITS3, EMS50 and EMS 51 despite the spacing and hyphen differences.
The closed list stores no units for FITS3 and EMS50; the catalog prints 21.50 and 5.00 units respectively.
The section heading appears three times with different program codes (MAS669/C/MCE669 and MAS669/MAS669B/MAS669C/MCE669); the first was used.
